title: Gradient hero
summary: linear-gradient() as a background image: a colourful banner with no image file.
explanation: A gradient is an image the browser draws for you, so it goes in background-image (or the background shorthand), not background-color.

linear-gradient(135deg, …) runs diagonally from the top-left. List two or more colours; the browser blends between them. Optional stop positions (#f97316 0%, #db2777 50%) control where each colour sits.
White text needs a gradient that stays dark enough everywhere, not just in the middle.
tryThis: Change 135deg to 90deg (left to right) and to 180deg (top to bottom).
Swap linear-gradient for radial-gradient(circle at top left, #f97316, #7c3aed).

children.text: A banner coloured entirely with CSS.
